description: Find law enforcement agencies in one state and their nine-character ORI codes, the identifier agency scope needs in fbi_get_crime_estimates, fbi_get_hate_crimes, fbi_get_arrests, and fbi_get_nibrs_breakdown. Fetches the state's full FBI CDE agency directory, filters it by words in the agency name, county, and agency type, sorts by agency name then ORI, and returns one page with the total match count and next_offset for the following page. Each agency carries its type, counties, and NIBRS reporting status. A code CDE has no directory for (AS, MP, or an unrecognized code) returns zero agencies with a notice.

agency_type.description: Agency type: City, County, Other State Agency, Other, State Police, University or College, or Tribal.

county.description: County name, case-insensitive (e.g. Bexar). Matches an agency when it equals any of the agency's counties, so an agency serving several counties matches each of them.

name_contains.description: Words or word fragments that must all appear in the agency name, in any order, case-insensitively (e.g. "san antonio police").

offset.description: Zero-based position in the sorted matches; pass next_offset from the previous page. Defaults to 0.

state_abbr.description: Two ASCII-letter state abbreviation (e.g. TX, DC, PR); case-insensitive.

name: fbi_search_agencies

agencies.description: This page of matching agencies, sorted by agency name, then ORI.

items.description: One agency from the CDE directory.

agency_name.description: Agency name as CDE lists it.

agency_type.description: CDE agency type, e.g. City, County, State Police.

counties.description: Counties the agency serves, as CDE lists them; NOT SPECIFIED when CDE ties the agency to no county.

is_nibrs.description: Whether CDE marks the agency as a NIBRS reporter.

nibrs_start_date.description: Date the agency began NIBRS reporting (YYYY-MM-DD); absent when CDE lists none.

ori.description: Nine-character ORI code; pass it as ori with scope "agency" to fbi_get_crime_estimates, fbi_get_hate_crimes, fbi_get_arrests, or fbi_get_nibrs_breakdown.

cap.description: The limit applied to this page.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page; absent on the last page.

notice.description: Why the page is empty or partial, and the call to make next.

offset.description: Zero-based position of the first agency on this page.

state_abbr.description: State code the directory was fetched for, uppercased.

total.description: Agencies matching the filters across the whole state directory, before paging.

truncated.description: True when more matching agencies follow this page; continue from next_offset.

title: FBI Search Agencies
